title: Development tooling is treated as a runtime dependency
description: packages.config declares a development-only package declared as a shipped dependency. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a development-only package declared as a shipped dependency.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a development-only package declared as a shipped dependency.
limitation: It matches a development-only package declared as a shipped dependency in the parsed packages.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
